sources.title: Selling F gas in cylinders or equipment
Fluorinated gas (F gas): guidance for users, producers and traders

facts.source_fact: For cylinder sales for purposes outside the specified installation/service uses, sellers should ask each customer for a letter of assurance.
The official guidance provides an F-gas customer letter of assurance template.
facts.expected_handling: Treat template as evidence mechanism, not a permit.

facts.source_fact: The customer letter confirms the customer is permitted to buy or collect F gas.
The customer letter must confirm no intentional atmospheric release unless technically necessary.
The customer letter must confirm steps will be taken to prevent F-gas leaks.
The customer letter confirms the customer does not need F-gas certification or qualifications for that purpose.
facts.expected_handling: Do not infer certification exemption beyond stated purpose.

facts.source_fact: This assurance route is separate from the certificate-check route for specified service uses.
The guidance applies to F gas and equipment already placed on the market in Great Britain.
Placed on the market is described as cleared customs for free circulation.
The assurance process does not itself produce an emissions quantity.
